scope: Text coverage: semantic relevance ordering, embedding shape/finiteness, invalid decision choices, explicit abstention, title faithfulness evaluation, empty/overlength input. The first five are covered by the existing tool-mode-recipes/embedding/decision tests; this artifact records the title-faithfulness evaluation.
method: Five representative documents were titled through the live text_title tool. Each completed title/description was checked against the source for invented names, numbers, versions or claims; a completion is faithful when every concrete detail is supported. Two long repeated documents were also run and are recorded as truncation failures, not as unfaithful titles.

cases.source: deploy job failed because the registry token expired; on-call rotated it and reran; no customer traffic affected
cases.title: Deploy job failure from expired registry token
cases.description: The deploy job failed because the registry token expired; the on-call engineer rotated the token and reran the job, and no customer traffic was affected.

cases.source: orders table restored into an isolated database; row counts and checksums verified; nine minutes; no mismatches
cases.title: Isolated Backup Restore Test for Orders Table
cases.description: The orders table was restored into an isolated database and row counts and checksums were verified; the test finished in nine minutes with no mismatches.

cases.source: requests must name service, ticket and owner; temporary access four hours; monthly review; emergency on-call lead
cases.title: Production Access Request, Review, and Emergency Approval Rules
cases.description: Requests must name a specific service, incident or change ticket, and approving owner; temporary access expires after four hours, standing access is reviewed monthly, and emergency access may be granted by the on-call lead.

cases.source: ingestion workers stopped for eleven minutes; consumer group restarted; no events lost; review recommends five-minute lag alert and runbook
cases.title: Ingestion Processing Interruption and Review Recommendations
cases.description: Ingestion workers stopped processing events for eleven minutes; the on-call engineer restarted the consumer group with no events lost, and the review recommends a five-minute lag alert and a restart runbook.

cases.source: version 2.4 adds incremental asset preparation and bounded download timeout; upgrades in place; fixes stale-cache rollback bug
cases.title: Version 2.4 Asset Preparation, Download Timeout, and Rollback Cache Fix
cases.description: Version 2.4 adds incremental asset preparation and a bounded download timeout, upgrades existing installations in place without re-downloading verified weights, and fixes a stale-cache bug after rollback.

cases.error: MODEL_OUTPUT_TRUNCATED (512 and 1024 token recipes); 2048 refused at activation

limitations: The title path still truncates on the two long repeated documents at the host provider output ceiling. That is a quality defect recorded separately; it is not an unfaithful title and it does not remove the evaluation coverage.
The decision and embedding legs are deterministic unit tests, not this model evaluation.
